401 Unauthorized when generating images with invalid API key

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import LiterLlm

do {
    let _req = try LiterLlm.createImageRequestFromJson("{\"model\":\"dall-e-3\",\"n\":1,\"prompt\":\"A cat\",\"size\":\"1024x1024\"}")
    guard let _apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["API_KEY"] else { fatalError("API_KEY must be set") }
    let _client = try createClient(apiKey: _apiKey, baseUrl: nil)
    _ = try await _client.imageGenerate(_req)
} catch {
    print("\(type(of: error)): \(error)")
}
```
